title: Dictionary: abra (v.)
srananText: abra 1) v. cross, cross over. Fosi yu ben e pai den botoman wan kwartyi fu abra a liba. (You used to pay the boatmen a quarter to cross the river). 2) v. pass an exam or a grade in school. Efu yu wani abra, yu mu leri yu les. (If you want to pass, you must study your lessons). 3) prep. across from. Mi e tan abra a kerki. (I live across from the church). 4) prep. over. Den plane no mag frei abra a foto. 5) prep. through. 6) prep. about. Den boi na tapu uku e taki abra a nowtu fu a kondre.
translation: 1) v. cross, cross over. Fosi yu ben e pai den botoman wan kwartyi fu abra a liba. (You used to pay the boatmen a quarter to cross the river). 2) v. pass an exam or a grade in school. Efu yu wani abra, yu mu leri yu les. (If you want to pass, you must study your lessons). 3) prep. across from. Mi e tan abra a kerki. (I live across from the church). 4) prep. over. Den plane no mag frei abra a foto. 5) prep. through. 6) prep. about. Den boi na tapu uku e taki abra a nowtu fu a kondre.
